policy: All currently deployed elfenbenstornet.se node origins N0–N7 are federation peers; same-domain remote spawning must not be denied because an engine was omitted from a SWI origin list.
cause: SWI sandbox derives remote spawn origin permission from load_uri_allowed_origins; the public N1–N4 startup lists omitted N5–N7 and N0.
changes: One central deployed-origin list used by SWI N1–N4 source/spawn and applicable browser-origin configuration
N5 and N7 no longer fail the SWI origin admission test merely because they are non-SWI implementations
N4 privately routes Trealla actor traffic through the same endpoint as N3
Trealla preserves write/writeln metadata at remote IO endpoints and serializes the required line ending

tests.end_to_end_peer_transport: Not requalified or deployed in this policy-correction turn

boundaries: Existing authentication and peer credentials still apply
N7 browser and owner APIs remain owner-only
Node profiles continue to determine available operations
Other engines and N7 peer provisioning have not been changed
